source.bibliography: Arthur Edward Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot (1911; text of the 1922 reprint).

upright.text_en: He symbolizes established strength, enterprise, effort, trade, commerce, discovery; those are his ships, bearing his merchandise, which are sailing over the sea. The card also signifies able co-operation in business, as if the successful merchant prince were looking from his side towards yours with a view to help you.

reversed.text_en: The end of troubles, suspension or cessation of adversity, toil and disappointment.

additional_upright.text_en: A very good card; collaboration will favour enterprise.

upright.text_ja: 彼は確立された力、事業、努力、交易、商業、発見を象徴する；海を渡っているのは、彼の商品を積んだ彼の船である。このカードはまた、事業での有能な協力を意味する。あたかも成功した商人の王が、自分の側からあなたの側を見て、援助しようとしているかのようである。
